Initial release of Caption Generator for Video — Auto-Generate Captions for Videos.

- Upload video files (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM up to 500MB) and auto-generate captions using cloud-based AI.
- Supports instructions such as adding subtitles in multiple languages, choosing text styles, and exporting in 1080p MP4 format.
- Fast processing (30–60 seconds per video) with automatic cloud session creation and status updates.
- Provides full workflow: upload, edit, preview, export, and download captioned videos.
- Built-in handling for credits, upload limits, and error codes for a smooth user experience.
